summary.text: Dan Tran is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Blanca Rubio (D).
A real estate professional who was born in Los Angeles and ran for the same seat in 2024, he advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Dan Tran was born in Los Angeles, California, and earned a high school diploma from Glendora High School, an associate degree from Citrus College in 1997 and a bachelor's degree from Azusa Pacific University in 2005.
His career experience includes working as a real estate professional.
In 2024 Tran advanced from the March primary for Assembly District 48 and lost the November general election to incumbent Blanca Rubio, 61.8 percent to 38.2 percent.
In the June 2, 2026 primary he again advanced alongside Rubio, receiving 34.7 percent of the vote.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Tran described himself as the child of immigrant refugee parents who grew up in Glendora and said he had 19 years of experience as a title sales manager at Fidelity National Title.
He listed community-focused leadership, sustainable homeownership programs, and education and opportunity among his campaign messages.
